moves.label: Quick Zabimaru Swipe
moves.description: Fast high blade swipe with a tiny active window and quick guarded recovery.
moves.reason: Short standing sword swipe hits high and returns quickly.

moves.label: Low Zabimaru Sweep
moves.description: Instant low sweep with very long active blade pressure across the floor.
moves.reason: The blade stays low through a long sliding sweep sequence.

moves.label: Zabimaru Body Slash
moves.description: Quick mid sword slash with a brief active cut and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Compact horizontal blade swing crosses the torso line.

moves.label: Zabimaru Driving Cut
moves.description: Fast mid driving slash with very long active blade travel and quick finish.
moves.reason: Long sequence keeps the sword extended at body height.

moves.label: Heavy Zabimaru Cleave
moves.description: Slow mid cleave with a long active sword arc and punishable windup.
moves.reason: Overhead-to-forward blade sequence reads as a committed mid cleave.

moves.label: Zabimaru Rising Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that lifts through a rising sword arc and recovers quickly.
moves.reason: Blade rises upward through the opponent line and already has launcher data.

moves.label: Low Zabimaru Knockdown
moves.description: Fast low knockdown slash with a brief hit window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Low blade sweep finishes as an authored knockdown ender.

moves.label: Low Zabimaru Feint
moves.description: Steady low blade feint with a long active sweep and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Low sequence moves the blade along the floor before snapping upright.

moves.label: Zabimaru Driving Sweep
moves.description: Slow low knockdown sweep with long active reach and a fast finish.
moves.reason: Crouched sliding blade sweep stays low and carries knockdown.

moves.label: Zabimaru Power Crush
moves.description: Quick mid knockdown crush with a very long active sword flourish.
moves.reason: Wide blade flourish and impact effect support a heavy mid knockdown.

moves.label: Crouch Blade Rush
moves.description: Instant mid crouch rush with long active blade pressure and short recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch move chains several low-stance sword swipes at body height.

moves.label: Crouch Zabimaru Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active window and high recovery.
moves.reason: Crouching upward sword cut matches the authored launch height.

moves.label: Overdrive Blade Jab
moves.description: Fast high overdrive slash with a short active bite and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive version mirrors the high Zabimaru swipe.

moves.label: Zabimaru Aura Drive
moves.description: Instant special knockdown drive with very long active snake-blade pressure.
moves.reason: Sustained segmented blade/aura sequence is the obvious special knockdown.

moves.label: Rising Blade Check
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising sword check with a modest active window.
moves.reason: While-standing command uses a compact body-height sword check.

moves.label: Rising Zabimaru Rush
moves.description: Instant mid rising rush with very long active blade travel and quick finish.
moves.reason: Rising sequence advances through repeated sword poses at mid height.

moves.label: Ducking Blade Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking slash with a short active bite and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Down-input version reuses the high blade swipe frames.

moves.label: Diagonal Blade Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active cut and high recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward sword cut is authored as a launcher and visually rises.

moves.label: Forward Zabimaru Slash
moves.description: Slow mid forward slash with a brief active blade arc and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward input produces a body-height Zabimaru swing.

moves.label: Forward Blade Check
moves.description: Steady mid forward check with a modest active sword poke and quick finish.
moves.reason: Forward-heavy variant is a compact mid sword check.

moves.label: Zabimaru Quick Slash
moves.description: Fast high quarter-circle slash with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle slash visually matches the quick high blade swipe.

moves.label: Zabimaru Tornado Burst
moves.description: Fast jumping mid burst with huge active time that works as a tornado knockdown.
moves.reason: Tumbling airborne sequence with impact effects supports tornado, jump, and knockdown.
